## Summary

Describe the page, content, integration, or user-facing change.

## Verification

List build, content, accessibility, and browser checks performed.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No patient-identifiable data, credentials, or private documents are included.
- [ ] Secrets are server-side and are not exposed through `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values.
- [ ] Clinical claims and source-dependent content have been reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
